extracted.intended_audience: Individuals and organisations seeking EU funding or tender opportunities (applicants, contractors, beneficiaries, public buyers)
extracted.subtask_short: applying for EU funding and tenders
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for finding, applying for, winning and managing European Commission funding and tender contracts, including eligibility, application steps, award/contract signature, post‑award management, and transparency obligations. Also covers where to find calls, tender procedures, and tools for public buyers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Find funding
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry point for locating available EU funding programmes and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: EU funding programmes
rubrics_metrics.description: EU funding programmes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overview of the different EU programmes that provide funding (useful to identify programme-specific rules and calls).

rubrics_metrics.name: Find calls for funding - by topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Find calls for funding - by topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Locate open calls grouped by thematic topics to identify relevant opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Before you apply: EU funding for beginners
rubrics_metrics.description: Before you apply: EU funding for beginners
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introductory guidance to help first-time applicants understand the basics of EU funding before starting an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: who can get funding?
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility: who can get funding?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines which individuals, organisations or types of entities may apply and receive funding; a fundamental screening criterion for any application.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to apply / The application process
rubrics_metrics.description: How to apply / The application process
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step procedural requirements for submitting an application (application forms, deadlines, submission channels and required documentation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Award procedure and contract signature
rubrics_metrics.description: Award procedure and contract signature
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and steps followed after selection up to contract signature, including formal award decisions and contractual formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing your project
rubrics_metrics.description: Managing your project
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ongoing project management expectations and responsibilities once funding is awarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-award obligations: reporting, deliverables, audits and communication
rubrics_metrics.description: What to expect once you are awarded a contract: reporting, deliverables, audits and communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies monitoring and compliance tasks (periodic reports, submission of deliverables, audit rights, communication obligations) that beneficiaries must meet during and after the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding by management mode
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding by management mode
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different management modalities for EU funds (e.g., direct, indirect, shared management) which determine procedures, intermediaries and responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial instruments: equity, guarantees, and loans
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial instruments: equity, guarantees, and loans
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative funding mechanisms to grants; guidance on the use, characteristics and suitability of equity, guarantees and loans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prizes
rubrics_metrics.description: Prizes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using prizes as a funding mechanism (distinct eligibility, conditions and award processes compared with grants or contracts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Seal of Excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: Seal of Excellence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference to the Seal of Excellence scheme (a label for high-quality proposals that could not be funded due to budget limits); guidance on follow-up and alternative funding routes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find calls for tender / Tender opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Find calls for tender
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How to search and locate procurement opportunities issued by the EU institutions and other contracting authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tender opportunities - by department / Tenders Electronic Daily (TED)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tender opportunities - by department; Tenders Electronic Daily (TED)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Channels for discovering tenders: browse by department or consult TED (the EU official public procurement portal).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures, guidelines for tenders / General tendering rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, guidelines for tenders; General tendering rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procurement rules and procedural guidance contractors must follow when participating in EU tenders (selection criteria, award criteria, timelines, contract performance rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information for contractors and beneficiaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Information for contractors and beneficiaries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical information directed at parties entering into contracts or receiving grants (rights, obligations, contact points, administrative procedures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data protection in public procurement procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Data protection in public procurement procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and guidance concerning personal data handling and compliance with data protection rules during procurement and contract execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tools for public buyers / e-Competence Centre
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools for public buyers; e-Competence Centre: tools and information to help public buyers get value for money and better policy outcomes for citizens
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources and tools aimed at contracting authorities to improve procurement practices, ensure value for money and achieve policy objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management of EU funding / EU budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Management of EU funding; EU budget
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overview and rules governing how EU funds are allocated and managed at the programme and budgetary level; useful for understanding funding flows and constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules and principles governing EU funding and tenders
rubrics_metrics.description: The rules and principles governing EU funding and tenders are designed to ensure that everyone has equal access to funding and funds are properly spent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level principles (equal access, sound financial management, transparency, fairness) that underpin eligibility, selection and implementation of funded actions and tenders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Become an expert at the European Commission
rubrics_metrics.description: How to become an expert for the European Commission. General qualifications required, roles available and where to register your interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and procedures for registering/qualifying as an external expert (useful for peer review panels and evaluation processes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Transparency and reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information on financial transparency, the implementation and results of the EU budget and its programmes, and how to report fraud; obligations related to openness and accountability.
